scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
application_mode: Online Citizen Portal or Lending Institution / CSC Assisted
target_beneficiaries: Urban, semi-urban, and rural street vendors vending in urban areas.
interest_subsidy: 7% interest subsidy credited directly to vendor's bank account quarterly.
digital_cashback: Up to ₹1,200 per year (₹100/month) for receiving payments via QR code.
prerequisites: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card or LoR (Letter of Recommendation) from ULB
Aadhaar card linked with active mobile number
Savings Bank Account with IFSC code for loan credit
Smartphone capable of UPI QR code operations

application_steps.portal_action: Navigate to pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in -> 'Apply for Loan' -> Check Vendor Status

input_fields.name: vendor_category
options: Category A: Possessing Vending Certificate / ID Card
Category B: Identified in ULB survey without ID card
Category C: Possessing Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
Category D: Peri-urban/Rural vendor vending in town

input_fields.name: vending_card_number_or_lor
input_fields.description: Certificate number or Town Vending Committee LoR number

application_steps.verification: ULB database validates vending status against municipal survey.

application_steps.portal_action: Log in with Aadhaar OTP on PM SVANidhi portal or through Lending Institution / CSC.

input_fields.name: preferred_lending_bank
input_fields.description: Preferred PSU Bank, Regional Rural Bank, or MFI

application_steps.verification: Aadhaar OTP authentication and credit agency verification.

application_steps.portal_action: Bank sanctions and disburses loan. UPI QR code (BHIM/Paytm/PhonePe/GPay) linked for cashback.
application_steps.output_artifact: Sanction letter and ₹10,000 direct credit into bank account with ₹1,200/year cashback activation.
